# configuration file /etc/apache2/apache2.conf:
ServerRoot "/etc/apache2"
Listen 80
IncludeOptional sites-enabled/*.conf

# configuration file /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/shop.conf:
<VirtualHost *:443>
    ServerName shop.example.com
    SSLEngine on
    SSLCertificateFile ssl/shop.crt
    SSLCertificateFile ssl/shop-int.crt
    SSLCertificateKeyFile ssl/shop.key
    SSLCertificateKeyFile ssl/shop-int.key
</VirtualHost>

# configuration file /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/www.conf:
<VirtualHost *:443>
    ServerName www.example.com
    ServerAlias example.com *.cdn.example.com
    SSLEngine on
    SSLCertificateFile ssl/www.crt
    SSLCertificateKeyFile ssl/www.key
    SSLCertificateChainFile ssl/www.chain.pem
</VirtualHost>
<VirtualHost *:80>
    ServerName www.example.com
    SSLEngine off
    Redirect permanent / https://www.example.com/
</VirtualHost>
